summary: HypoExplorer estimates one sex-adjusted maternal PRRSV-minus-control effect across 38 saline-treated offspring. The supplement reports 159 selected maternal main-effect rows from the full factorial study, and Figure 5 shows saline effects separately for males and females. The public-source review found no author result for the registered contrast. [Manuscript](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11283907/) · [Supplement](https://databank.illinois.edu/datasets/IDB-8635710)
openIssues: Reopen if the authors provide a saline-only gene table or fitted contrast with documented sex adjustment and direction.
